polls.description: OpenAI faces scrutiny over its handling of a ChatGPT user who discussed violent plans months before carrying out a school shooting, raising questions about AI safety monitoring and reporting protocols.
polls.question: Should OpenAI have alerted police about the shooter's ChatGPT conversations?

polls.description: Major Indian conglomerates and global tech giants are making massive AI investments to establish India as a global AI powerhouse.
polls.question: Will India's massive AI investments succeed in creating a global tech superpower?
